title: Introducing enhanced custom event buses in Amazon EventBridge for enterprise-scale event-driven applications
contentSnippet: Amazon EventBridge announces an enhanced custom event bus for organizations scaling event-driven applications across teams and accounts. Deploy a single event bus shared across all AWS accounts in your organization, with ordering guarantees, a simplified Subscriber resource, and improved economics at scale.
